verdict.rationale: Bolna exposes a broad API surface (agent create/update, extraction categories, call summary toggle, workflows, SIP trunking, quickstarts) plus a CLI and MCP server that mirror many dashboard actions, suggesting strong API-first design. However there is no evidence of a published OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe returned 404s) and several UI-only features (Agent Studio's guided generation, Settings→Integrations dashboard, call history/analytics viewer) are not shown to have direct API equivalents. Missing for 10: a complete OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, explicit API parity for Agent Studio and analytics/call-history dashboards, and confirmation that every UI toggle/setting has a matching API endpoint.
